summary.zh: 玄奘从长安出发，踏上西行求法之路。
summary.en: Xuanzang leaves Chang’an on his pilgrimage to the west in search of Buddhist scriptures.

description.zh: 629 年秋，玄奘从长安出发，经秦州、兰州、凉州，向西域行进。
description.en: In autumn 629, Xuanzang left Chang’an and traveled through Qinzhou, Lanzhou, and Liangzhou toward the Western Regions.

summary.en: Xuanzang reaches Qinzhou and continues west.

description.zh: 玄奘沿丝绸之路南道西行，抵达秦州。
description.en: Xuanzang traveled west along the southern route of the Silk Road and reached Qinzhou.

summary.en: Xuanzang reaches Lanzhou and crosses the Yellow River.

description.zh: 玄奘经兰州渡黄河，继续向河西走廊前进。
description.en: Xuanzang crossed the Yellow River at Lanzhou and continued toward the Hexi Corridor.

summary.en: Xuanzang reaches Liangzhou, preaches, and prepares to leave the frontier.

description.zh: 玄奘在凉州停留讲经，随后前往瓜州。
description.en: Xuanzang stayed at Liangzhou to preach before heading to Guazhou.

summary.en: Xuanzang reaches Guazhou and prepares to cross Yumen Pass.

description.zh: 瓜州是唐代河西通往西域的要冲，玄奘在此准备出关。
description.en: Guazhou was a key gateway from the Hexi Corridor to the Western Regions; Xuanzang prepared to cross the frontier there.

summary.en: Xuanzang crosses Yumen Pass at night and enters the Western Regions.

description.zh: 玄奘在向导帮助下绕过玉门关，进入莫贺延碛。
description.en: With a guide, Xuanzang bypassed Yumen Pass and entered the Moheyan Desert.

summary.en: King Qu Wentai of Gaochang welcomes Xuanzang and supports his journey.

description.zh: 玄奘抵达高昌，高昌王麴文泰与之结为兄弟，提供人马与物资。
description.en: Xuanzang reached Gaochang, where King Qu Wentai befriended him and provided men, horses, and supplies.

summary.en: Xuanzang reaches Karasahr and continues to Kucha.

description.zh: 玄奘经焉耆进入塔里木盆地北道。
description.en: Xuanzang passed through Karasahr into the northern route of the Tarim Basin.

description.zh: 玄奘在龟兹停留，观察当地佛教与音乐，随后翻越凌山。
description.en: Xuanzang stayed at Kucha, observed local Buddhism and music, and then crossed the Bedel Pass.

summary.en: Xuanzang crosses the Bedel Pass into Central Asia.

description.zh: 凌山即今别迭里山口，玄奘一行翻越天山，进入中亚草原。
description.en: The Bedel Pass, known as Lingshan in Tang sources, took Xuanzang across the Tianshan into the Central Asian steppe.

description.zh: 玄奘在碎叶见到西突厥统叶护可汗，获准继续西行。
description.en: At Suyab, Xuanzang met the Western Turkic khagan Tong Yabghu and received permission to continue west.

description.zh: 撒马尔罕是粟特重镇，玄奘在此了解中亚佛教与商业。
description.en: Samarkand was a major Sogdian city; Xuanzang studied Central Asian Buddhism and trade there.

description.en: The Iron Gate was a key pass south of Samarkand; Xuanzang entered Tokharistan through it.

description.zh: 玄奘在巴米扬瞻仰石窟大佛，记录当地佛教盛况。
description.en: At Bamiyan, Xuanzang visited the colossal cliff Buddhas and recorded the flourishing local Buddhism.

description.en: Kapisa was an important Buddhist center in the ancient Gandhara region.

description.en: Xuanzang studied Yogacara texts at Nalanda and became a renowned monk.

description.en: King Harsha held a great assembly at Kanauj, where Xuanzang took part in debates and won wide renown.

description.en: In 635, Xuanzang began his return journey with a large collection of scriptures and Buddhist images.
